description_en: Queries transcoding jobs in batches by job IDs
description_zh: 通过转码作业ID，批量查询转码作业
name: QueryJobList

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the transcoding jobs.
You can specify up to 10 IDs at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
You can obtain the IDs from the MPS console (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) by choosing Job Management, or from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29226.html operation.

If you do not specify this parameter, the `InvalidParameter` error code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
转码作业ID。
一次最多查询10个，使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
可以通过MPS控制台 (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) > 任务管理获取，也可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29226.html的返回参数中获取。

如果不传入此参数，则会返回`InvalidParameter`（参数无效）错误码
parameters.name: job_ids

items.description_en: The details of the transcoding job

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the job fails. This parameter is not returned if the job is successful
Code.description_zh: 任务失败时的错误码。成功则不返回此参数

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job was added. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreationTime.description_zh: 作业添加时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the job was completed. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
FinishTime.description_zh: 作业完成时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket of the input file

Location.description_en: The OSS location of the input file

Object.description_en: The OSS object of the input file

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The result of the MNS message sent to notify the user of job completion
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成的消息结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned upon failure. This parameter is not returned if the execution is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。执行成功则不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned upon failure. This parameter is not returned if the execution is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。执行成功则不返回此参数
ErrorMessage.example: The resource operated “%s” cannot be found.

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the message returned upon success

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the job fails. This parameter is not returned if the job is successful
Message.description_zh: 任务失败时的消息。成功则不返回此参数
Message.example: The specified parameter "%s" cannot be null.

Audio.description_en:
The audio configurations.
If the audio configurations are specified in the request parameters, they overwrite the corresponding parameters in the specified transcoding template
Audio.description_zh:
音频配置。

如果请求参数中指定了音频配置则覆盖指定转码模板中的对应参数

Bitrate.description_en:
The audio bitrate of the output file.

Unit: Kbps.
Default value: 128
Bitrate.description_zh:
输出文件的音频码率。

单位：Kbps。
默认值：128

Channels.description_en:
The number of sound channels.
Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8.
Default value: 2

Codec.description_en:
The audio encoding format.
Valid values: aac, mp3, vorbis, and flac.
Default value: aac
Codec.description_zh:
音频编解码格式。

支持aac、mp3、vorbis、flac。

默认值：aac

Profile.description_en: The audio encoding preset. When Codec is set to aac, valid values are aaclow, aache, aachev2, aacld, and aaceld
Profile.description_zh: 音频编码预置。当Codec为aac时可取值：aaclow、aache、aachev2、aacld、aaceld

Samplerate.description_en:
The sampling rate.
Valid values: 22050, 32000, 44100, 48000, and 96000.
Unit: Hz.
Default value: 44100.
If the video container format is FLV and the audio encoding format is MP3, the sampling rates 32000, 48000, and 96000 are not supported. If the audio encoding format is MP3, the sampling rate 96000 is not supported
Samplerate.description_zh:
采样率。

支持22050、32000、44100、48000、96000。

单位：Hz。

默认值：44100。

若视频容器格式为flv，音频编解码格式选择为mp3时，采样率不支持32000、48000、96000；音频编解码格式为mp3时，采样率不支持96000

Level.description_en: The volume adjustment level. Default value: -20db

Method.description_en:
The volume adjustment method. Valid values:

auto: Automatic adjustment.

dynamic: Dynamic adjustment.

linear: Linear adjustment
Method.description_zh:
音量调整方式。可取值：

auto：自动调整。

dynamic：动态调整。

linear：线性调整

AudioStreamMap.description_en:
The index of the audio stream.

Format: 0:a:{index}. Example: 0:a:0.

The index indicates the subscript of the audio stream in the audio stream list. The index starts from 0.

If this parameter is not specified, the default audio stream is selected
AudioStreamMap.description_zh:
音频流序号。

格式：格式：0:a:{序号}，示例：0:a:0。

序号的含义是音频流列表的下标，序号从0开始。

若未设置，选择默认的音频流

TimeSpan.description_en: The time span of the clip

Duration.description_en:
The duration.

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`.
Example: 01:00:59.999.

Or:

Format: `sssss[.SSS]`.
Example: 32000.23
Duration.description_zh:
持续时长。

格式：`hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`。
示例：01:00:59.999。

或者

格式：`sssss[.SSS]`。
示例：32000.23

Seek.description_en:
The start time.  

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`.

Example: 01:59:59.999.

Or:

Format: `sssss[.SSS]`.

Example: 32000.23
Seek.description_zh:
开始时间点。  

格式：`hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`。

示例：01:59:59.999。

或者

格式：`sssss[.SSS]`。

示例：32000.23

Format.description_en:
The container format.

Default value: mp4.

Valid values for video transcoding: flv, mp4, HLS (m3u8+ts), and MPEG-DASH (MPD+fMP4).

Valid values for audio transcoding: mp3, mp4, ogg, flac, and m4a.

Valid values for images: gif and WEBP. If the container format is gif, the VideoCodec parameter must be set to GIF.

If the container format is webp, the VideoCodec parameter must be set to WEBP.

If the container format is flv, the VideoCodec parameter cannot be set to H265
Format.description_zh:
容器格式。

默认值：mp4。

视频转码可取值flv、mp4、HLS（m3u8+ts）、MPEG-DASH（MPD+fMP4）。

音频转码可取值mp3、mp4、ogg、flac、m4a。

图片可取值gif、WEBP。容器格式为gif时，VideoCodec设置只能设置为GIF。

容器格式为webp时，VideoCodec设置只能设置为WEBP。

容器格式为flv时，VideoCodec不能设置为H265

DeWatermark.description_en: The blurring settings. This is a JSON object. For more information, see the blurring details in [Parameter details]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）
DeWatermark.description_zh: 模糊处理，JSON对象。更多信息请参见[参数详情]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）中的模糊处理详情

Encryption.description_en: The data encryption settings. Only output in M3U8 format is supported
Encryption.description_zh: 数据加密，只支持m3u8格式的输出

Key.description_en: The key used to encrypt the video

KeyType.description_en:
The key encryption method. Valid values: Base64 and KMS.
For example, if the key is `"encryptionkey128"`, the value is `Base64("encryptionkey128")` or `KMS(Base64("encryptionkey128"))`
KeyType.description_zh:
密钥加密方式，可取值：Base64、KMS。

例如密钥为`"encryptionkey128"`，则`Base64("encryptionkey128")`，或`KMS(Base64("encryptionkey128")`

KeyUri.description_en: The access URL of the key, which is Base64-encoded
KeyUri.description_zh: 密钥的访问URL，使用BASE64进行编码

SkipCnt.description_en: The number of initial segments that are not encrypted. This allows the video to start playing quickly
SkipCnt.description_zh: 前面不加密的片数（视频能快速播放起来）

Type.description_en: The encryption type. Valid value: hls-aes-128

M3U8NonStandardSupport.description_en: The non-standard M3U8 support settings. This is a JSON object. For more information, see the non-standard M3U8 parameter support details in [Parameter details]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）
M3U8NonStandardSupport.description_zh: m3u8非标准支持，JSON对象。更多信息请参见[参数详情]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）中的m3u8非标准参数支持详情

TS.description_en: The non-standard support settings for TS files. This is a JSON object. For more information, see the TS parameter support details in [Parameter details]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）
TS.description_zh: JSON对象，TS文件相关非标准支持。更多信息请参见[参数详情]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）中的TS参数支持详情

Md5Support.description_en:
Specifies whether to support outputting the MD5 hash value of the TS file in the M3U8 file. Valid values:
true: Supported.
false: Not supported
Md5Support.description_zh:
是否支持在m3u8文件中输出TS的md5值。可取值：

true：支持。

false：不支持

SizeSupport.description_en:
Specifies whether to support outputting the size of the TS file in the M3U8 file. Valid values:
true: Supported.
false: Not supported
SizeSupport.description_zh:
是否支持在m3u8文件中输出TS文件的大小。可取值：

true：支持。

false：不支持

MergeConfigUrl.description_en:
The URL of the concatenation configuration file. You can specify either MergeList or MergeConfigUrl.

The configuration file specified by MergeConfigUrl supports a maximum of 50 clips.

MergeConfigUrl is the URL of the concatenation configuration file. Only configuration files stored in OSS are supported, and you must ensure that MPS has the authorization and access permissions. For more information about the file content, see the concatenation parameter details.

Example of the file content: `{"MergeList":[{"MergeURL":"http://exampleBucket****.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/video_01.mp4"}]}`
MergeConfigUrl.description_zh:
拼接配置文件URL地址。MergeList与MergeConfigUrl两个参数只支持二选一。

MergeConfigUrl指定的配置文件允许50个拼接片段上限。

MergeConfigUrl是拼接配置文件URL地址。只支持存放在OSS上的配置文件，且需要保证有授权给MPS可访问权限，文件内部内容参见拼接参数详情。

mergeConfigfile文件内部内容示例：`{"MergeList":[{"MergeURL":"http://exampleBucket****.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/video_01.mp4"}]}`

Merge.description_en: The concatenation settings. A maximum of four MergeURLs are supported

Duration.description_en:
The duration.

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.
Example: 01:59:59.999 or 32000.23
Duration.description_zh:
持续时间。

格式：`hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`或者`sssss[.SSS]`。
示例：01:59:59.999或者32000.23

MergeURL.description_en:
The URL of the clip to be concatenated.

Example: `http://example-bucket-.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/example-object.flv`.
The object name must be URL-encoded in UTF-8. For more information, see [URL encoding]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html）
MergeURL.description_zh:
拼接片段地址。

示例：`http://example-bucket-.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/example-object.flv`。
Object需要经过URL Encode，采用UTF-8编码。更多信息，请参见[URL编码说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html）

RoleArn.description_en: The role information used for authorization
RoleArn.description_zh: 代理授权使用的角色信息

Start.description_en:
The start time.

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.
Example: 01:59:59.999 or 32000.23
Start.description_zh:
起始时间点。

格式：`hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`或者`sssss[.SSS]`。
示例：01:59:59.999或者32000.23

MultiSpeedInfo.description_en: The information about the accelerated job. This information is available only for jobs submitted through an accelerated MPS queue and is not available for legacy accelerated jobs
MultiSpeedInfo.description_zh: 倍速作业信息。使用倍速管道提交的任务才有（老版倍速无该信息）

Code.description_en: The error code, which is returned when the acceleration feature is not actually enabled
Code.description_zh: 错误码（未实际启用倍速时的说明）

DowngradePolicy.description_en: The downgrade policy when acceleration is not supported
DowngradePolicy.description_zh: 不支持倍速时的降级策略

Duration.description_en: The duration of the output video

Enable.description_en: Indicates whether the acceleration feature is enabled

Message.description_en: The error message, which is returned when the acceleration feature is not actually enabled
Message.description_zh: 错误信息（未实际启用倍速时的说明）

TimeCost.description_en: The time consumed by the job

MuxConfig.description_en: The transcoding muxing settings. If this parameter is set in the request parameters, it overwrites the corresponding parameter in the specified transcoding template
MuxConfig.description_zh: 转码封包配置。转码封包配置。如果请求参数中设置了此参数，则覆盖指定转码模板中的对应参数

DitherMode.description_en: The color dithering method for the palette. Valid values: sierra and bayer
DitherMode.description_zh: 调色板颜色抖动方式。可取值：sierra、bayer

FinalDelay.description_en: The pause time of the last frame. Unit: centiseconds
FinalDelay.description_zh: 终帧暂停时间。单位：厘秒

IsCustomPalette.description_en:
Specifies whether to use a custom palette. Valid values:

true: Custom.

false: Non-custom
IsCustomPalette.description_zh:
自定义调色板功能。可取值：

true：自定义。

false：非自定义

Segment.description_en: The segment configuration. The value is a JSON object

Opening.description_en: The opening list. The value is a JSON object

The height.

Valid values: (0, 4096), -1, and full.
-1 indicates the value of the source video.
full indicates that the screen is filled.

高。

Start.description_en:

从0开始延迟多长时间后，显示开板视频。

默认值：0

Width.description_en:
The width.

-1 indicates the value of the source video.
full indicates that the screen is filled.

宽。

范围：(0,4096)、1、full。
-1代表片源的值。
full表示填满画面。
默认值：-1

The character encoding of the external captions.

Valid values: UTF-8, GBK, BIG5, and auto.

Default value: auto.

When the character encoding of the external captions is set to auto, false detection may occur. Specify a specific character encoding
CharEnc.description_zh:
外部字幕字符编码。

范围：UTF-8、GBK、BIG5、auto。

默认：auto。

外部字幕字符编码设置为auto时，存在误检情况，建议您指定具体的字符编码

FontName.description_zh: 外挂字幕转换成硬字幕对应的字体名称。默认值：SimSum。更多信息，请参见[字体列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59950.html）

外部输入字幕文件。

目前支持srt、ass格式。更多信息请参见[参数详情]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）中的Input参数。

IsHalfSample.description_en:

true: Yes.

false: No
IsHalfSample.description_zh:
是否获取采样率相关参数。可取值：

true：是。

false：否

BgColor.description_en: The background color used to fill the blank space when the width and height of the tail slate video are smaller than those of the main video. Default value: White. For valid values, see [bgcolor]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）
BgColor.description_zh: 如果尾板视频的宽、高小于正片时，设置空白处填充的背景色。默认为White，取值请参见[bgcolor]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）

BlendDuration.description_en: The duration of the transition between the main video and the tail slate video. The transition effect is fade-in and fade-out: the last frame of the main video is displayed while the tail slate video is played. The last frame of the main video gradually darkens, and the tail slate video gradually brightens. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0
BlendDuration.description_zh: 正片视频和尾板视频过渡的时长。过渡的效果是淡入淡出：正片显示最后一帧，同时播放尾板视频，正片最后一帧逐步变暗，尾板视频逐步变亮。单位秒，默认0

Height.description_en:
The height.

Valid values: (0, 4096), -1, and full.

-1 indicates the value of the source video.
full indicates that the screen is filled.
Default value: -1
Height.description_zh:
高。

范围：(0,4096)、-1、full。

-1代表片源的值。
full表示填满画面。
默认为-1

IsMergeAudio.description_en:
Specifies whether to concatenate the audio content of the tail slate video. Valid values:

true: Concatenate.

false: Do not concatenate
IsMergeAudio.description_zh:
是否要拼接尾板视频的音频内容。可取值：

true：拼接。

false：不拼接

Start.description_en: The start time of the tail slate video

TailUrl.description_en: The OSS URL of the tail slate video

Width.description_en:
The width. Valid values: (0, 4096), -1, and full.

-1 indicates the value of the source video.
full indicates that the screen is filled.
Default value: -1
Width.description_zh:
宽，范围：（0，4096）、-1、full。

-1代表片源的值。
full表示填满画面。
默认为-1

TransConfig.description_en:
The general transcoding configurations.
If this value is specified in the request parameters, it overwrites the corresponding parameter in the specified transcoding template
TransConfig.description_zh:
转码通用配置。

如果请求参数中设置了该值，则覆盖指定转码模板中的对应参数

AdjDarMethod.description_en: The resolution adjustment method. Default value: none. Valid values: rescale, crop, pad, and none
AdjDarMethod.description_zh: 分辨率改写方式。默认值：none。可取值：rescale、crop、pad、none

IsCheckAudioBitrate.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. If the output audio bitrate is greater than the audio bitrate of the media source, the output audio bitrate is considered equal to the audio bitrate of the media source, and the configured audio bitrate parameter does not take effect. The priority of this parameter is lower than that of IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.
true: The audio bitrate is checked.
false: The audio bitrate is not checked.
Default value:
    - If this parameter is left empty and the codec is different from that of the input source: false.
    - If this parameter is left empty and the codec is the same as that of the input source: true
IsCheckAudioBitrate.description_zh:
是否检查音频码率。当输出音频码率大于媒体源音频码率时，则视为输出音频码率等于媒体源音频码率，即设置的音频码率参数不会生效。此值优先级小于IsCheckAudioBitrateFail。
true表示检查。
false表示不检查。
默认值：
    - 参数为空，并且codec和输入源不一样：false。
    - 参数为空，并且codec和输入源一样：true

IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. If the output audio bitrate is greater than the audio bitrate of the media source, the transcoding is not performed and a transcoding failure is returned. The priority of this parameter is higher than that of IsCheckAudioBitrate.
true: The audio bitrate is checked.
false: The audio bitrate is not checked.
Default value: false
IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_zh:
是否检查音频码率。当输出音频码率大于媒体源音频码率时，则不进行转码，直接返回转码失败，此值优先级大于IsCheckAudioBitrate。
true表示检查。

false表示不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckReso.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the resolution. If the output resolution is greater than the input resolution in width or height, the output resolution is considered equal to the input resolution.
true: The resolution is checked.
false: The resolution is not checked.
Default value: false
IsCheckReso.description_zh:
是否检查分辨率。如果输出分辨率大于输入分辨率（判断条件是宽或高），则视为输出分辨率等于输入分辨率。
true表示检查。

false表示不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckResoFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the resolution. If the output resolution is greater than the input resolution in width or height, a transcoding failure is returned.
true: The resolution is checked.
false: The resolution is not checked.
Default value: false
IsCheckResoFail.description_zh:
是否检查分辨率。如果输出分辨率大于输入分辨率（判断条件是宽或高），则返回转码失败。
true表示检查。

false表示不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckVideoBitrate.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the video bitrate. If the output video bitrate is greater than the input video bitrate, the output video bitrate is considered equal to the input video bitrate.
true: The video bitrate is checked.
false: The video bitrate is not checked.
Default value: false
IsCheckVideoBitrate.description_zh:
是否检查视频码率。如果视频输出码率大于视频输入码率，则视为视频输出码率等于视频输入码率。
true表示检查。

false表示不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckVideoBitrateFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the bitrate. If the output video bitrate is greater than the video bitrate of the media source, the transcoding is not performed and a transcoding failure is returned. The priority of this parameter is higher than that of IsCheckVideoBitrate.
true: The bitrate is checked.
false: The bitrate is not checked.
Default value: false
IsCheckVideoBitrateFail.description_zh:
是否检查码率。当输出视频码率大于媒体源视频码率时，则不进行转码，直接返回转码失败。此值优先级大于IsCheckVideoBitrate。

true表示检查。

false表示不检查。

默认值：false

TransMode.description_en:
The transcoding mode.
Valid values: onepass, twopass, and CBR.
Default value: onepass
TransMode.description_zh:
转码模式。

可选范围：onepass、twopass、CBR。
默认值：onepass

Bitrate.description_en: The average video bitrate. Unit: Kbit/s

BitrateBnd.description_en: The range of the average video bitrate

Bufsize.description_en:
The buffer size.
Unit: Kb.
Default value: 6000
Bufsize.description_zh:
缓冲区大小。

单位：Kb。
默认值：6000

Codec.description_en:
The encoding format.
Valid values: H.264 and H.265.
Default value: H.264
Codec.description_zh:
编解码格式。

支持H.264、H.265。
默认值：H.264

Crf.description_en:
The constant rate factor (CRF) for bitrate and quality control.
Default value: When the encoding format is H.264, the default value is 23. When the encoding format is H.265, the default value is 26.
If Crf is specified, the Bitrate setting becomes invalid
Crf.description_zh:
码率-质量控制因子。

默认值：编码格式为H264，默认值为23。编码格式为H265，默认值为26。
如果设置了Crf，则Bitrate的设置失效

Crop.description_en:
The video cropping settings. Two cropping methods are supported:
Automatic detection and cropping of black borders. Set this parameter to border.
Custom cropping. The parameter format is width:height:left:top
Crop.description_zh:
视频画面裁剪，支持2种方式：
自动检测黑边并裁切，设置为border。
自定义裁切，参数格式为width:height:left:top

Degrain.description_en: The strength of the independent denoising algorithm

Fps.description_en:
The frame rate.
Unit: fps.
If the frame rate of the input file exceeds 60 fps, the value 60 is used.
Default value: the frame rate of the input file
Fps.description_zh:
帧率。

单位：fps。

当输入文件帧率超过60时取60。
默认值：取输入文件帧率

Gop.description_en:
The maximum time interval or maximum number of frames between keyframes. Unit: seconds.
Default value: 250.
No unit is used when this parameter specifies the maximum number of frames
Gop.description_zh:
关键帧间最大时间间隔或最大帧数。单位：秒。

默认值：250。

最大帧数时无单位

Height.description_en:
The height.
Unit: px.
Default value: the original height of the video
Height.description_zh:
高。

单位：px。
默认值：视频原始高度

Maxrate.description_en: The peak video bitrate. Unit: Kbit/s

Pad.description_en:
The black borders added to the video.
Unit: px.
Parameter format: width:height:left:top
Pad.description_zh:
视频贴黑边。

单位：px。

参数格式：width:height:left:top

PixFmt.description_en: The video color format. Valid values: standard color formats such as yuv420p and yuvj420p
PixFmt.description_zh: 视频颜色格式。范围：yuv420p，yuvj420p等标准颜色格式

Preset.description_en:
The video algorithm preset. Default value: medium. Valid values:
veryfast: ultra-fast.
fast: fast.
medium: medium.
slow: slow.
slower: ultra-slow
Preset.description_zh:
视频算法器预置。默认值：medium。可取值：

veryfast：超快。

fast：快。

medium：中等。

slow：慢。

slower：超慢

Profile.description_en:
The encoding profile. Valid values: baseline, main, and high.
If you have multiple resolutions, set the profile of the lowest resolution to baseline to ensure playback on low-end devices. Set the profiles of other resolutions to main or high.
baseline: for mobile devices.
main: for standard-resolution devices.
high: for high-resolution devices.
Default value: high
Profile.description_zh:
编码级别。支持baseline、main、high。

如果您有多个清晰度，建议最低清晰度配置成baseline，以保证最低端设备可播放。其他清晰度配置为main或high。

baseline：针对移动设备。
main：针对标准分辨率设备。
high：针对高分辨率设备。
默认值：high

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan mode. Valid values:
Not set: The original mode of the input file is used.
auto: automatic deinterlacing.
progressive: progressive scan.
interlaced: interlaced scan.
Default value: empty, which means not set.
Best practices: Interlaced scan saves more bandwidth than progressive scan, but the image quality is poor. Therefore, progressive scan is widely used in mainstream video production.
If you set progressive scan or interlaced scan that does not match the original raw mode, the transcoding fails.
Set this parameter to the original raw mode or automatic deinterlacing to improve compatibility
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描模式。取值如下：
不设置：按输入文件的原始模式。
auto：自动去隔行。
progressive：顺序扫描（逐行扫描）。
interlaced：交叉扫描（隔行扫描）。
默认值：空，即不设置。

最佳实践：交叉扫描虽然比顺序扫描更节省数据量，但画质不佳，所以现在主流视频制作都采用顺序扫描。
如果您设置了顺序扫描或交叉扫描，但与原视频模式不符，会导致转码失败。
建议您设置原视频模式或自动去隔行，以提高兼容性

Width.description_en:
The width.
Unit: px.
Default value: the original width of the video
Width.description_zh:
宽。

单位：px。
默认值：视频原始宽度

VideoStreamMap.description_en: The index of the video stream. The index starts from 0 and indicates the subscript of the video stream in the video stream list. If this parameter is not specified, the default video stream is selected
VideoStreamMap.description_zh: 视频流序号。序号从0开始，序号的含义是视频流列表的下标，若不设置，选择默认的视频流

WaterMarkConfigUrl.description_en: The URL of the watermark configuration file

Dx.description_en:
The horizontal offset of the watermark image relative to the output video. If this value is specified in the request parameters, it overwrites the corresponding parameter in the watermark template. Default value: 0. The value can be in one of the following formats:
Integer: the offset in pixels.
    - Valid values: [8,4096].
    - Unit: px.
Decimal: the ratio of the horizontal offset to the width of the output resolution.
    - Valid values: (0,1).
    - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Excess decimal places are automatically discarded
Dx.description_zh:
水印图片相对输出视频的水平偏移量。如果请求参数中设置了此值，则覆盖水印模板对应参数。默认值为0。值有两种形式：

整数型：代表偏移像素值。

    - 范围：[8,4096]。

    - 单位：px。

小数型：代表水平偏移量与输出分辨率宽的比率。

    - 范围：（0,1)。

    - 支持四位小数，例如：0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃

Dy.description_en:
The vertical offset of the watermark image relative to the output video. If this value is specified in the request parameters, it overwrites the vertical offset of the watermark image relative to the output video in the watermark template. The value can be in one of the following formats:
Integer: the vertical offset of the watermark image relative to the output video in pixels.
    - Valid values: [8,4096].
    - Unit: px.
Decimal: the ratio of the vertical offset of the watermark image relative to the output video.
    - Valid values: (0,1).
    - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Excess decimal places are automatically discarded
Dy.description_zh:
水印图片相对输出视频的垂直偏移量。如果在请求参数中设置了此值，则覆盖水印模板对应水印图片相对输出视频的垂直偏移量。值有两种形式：

整数型：代表水印图片相对输出视频的垂直偏移量像素。

    - 范围：[8，4096]。

    - 单位：px。

小数型：代表水印图片相对输出视频的垂直偏移量比率。

    - 范围：(0,1)。

    - 支持4位小数，例如：0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃

Height.description_en:
The height of the watermark image. If this value is specified in the request parameters, it overwrites the height of the watermark image in the watermark template. The value can be in one of the following formats:
Integer: the height of the watermark image in pixels.
    - Valid values: [8,4096].
    - Unit: px.
Decimal: the ratio of the watermark image height to the height of the output video resolution.
    - Valid values: (0,1).
    - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Excess decimal places are automatically discarded
Height.description_zh:
水印图片搞高。如果在请求参数中设置了此值，则覆盖水印模板对应水印图片高。值有两种形式：

整数型：代表水印图片高的像素值。

    - 范围：[8，4096]。

    - 单位：px。

小数型：代表相对输出视频分辨率高的比率。

    - 范围：(0,1)。

    - 支持4位小数，例如：0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃

InputFile.description_en: The input file for the watermark. PNG images and MOV files are supported as input files
InputFile.description_zh: 水印输入文件。目前支持png图片、mov文件作为输入文件

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket of the input file

Location.description_en: The OSS location of the input file

Object.description_en: The OSS object of the input file

ReferPos.description_en:
The position of the watermark. If this value is specified in the request parameters, it overwrites the corresponding parameter in the watermark template. Valid values:
TopRight: upper right.
TopLeft: upper left.
BottomRight: lower right.
BottomLeft: lower left
ReferPos.description_zh:
水印的位置。如果请求参数中设置了此值，测覆盖水印模板对应参数。可取值：

TopRight：右上。

TopLeft：左上。

BottomRight：右下。

BottomLeft：左下

Type.description_en:
The watermark type. If this parameter is specified in the request parameters, it overwrites the corresponding parameter in the watermark template. For more information, see [Parameter details]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）. Valid values:
Image: image watermark.
Text: text watermark
Type.description_zh:
水印类型。如果请求参数中设置了此参数，则此值覆盖水印模板对应参数。更多信息，请参见[参数详情]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html）。可取值：

Image：图片水印。

Text：文字水印

Width.description_en:
The width of the watermark image. If this value is specified in the request parameters, it overwrites the width of the watermark image in the watermark template. The value can be in one of the following formats:
Integer: the width of the watermark image in pixels.
    - Valid values: [8,4096].
    - Unit: px.
Decimal: the ratio of the watermark image width to the width of the output video resolution.
    - Valid values: (0,1).
    - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Excess decimal places are automatically discarded
Width.description_zh:
水印图片宽。如果在请求参数中设置了此值，则覆盖水印模板对应水印图片宽。值有两种形式：

整数型：代表水印图片宽的像素值。

    - 范围：[8，4096]。

    - 单位：px。

小数型：代表相对输出视频分辨率宽的比率。

    - 范围：(0,1)。

    - 支持4位小数，例如：0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃

PipelineId.description_en: The ID of the MPS queue

State.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:
Submitted: The job is submitted.
Transcoding: The job is being transcoded.
TranscodeSuccess: The transcoding is successful.
TranscodeFail: The transcoding failed.
TranscodeCancelled: The transcoding is canceled
State.description_zh:
作业状态。

Submitted：作业已提交。
Transcoding：转码中。
TranscodeSuccess：转码成功。
TranscodeFail：转码失败。
TranscodeCancelled：转码取消

SubmitTime.description_en: The time when the job is dequeued and submitted for execution. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
SubmitTime.description_zh: 任务出队提交执行的时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
SubmitTime.title_zh: 任务出队提交执行的时间

String.description_en: The IDs of the jobs that do not exist

items.description_en: The list of IDs of the transcoding jobs that do not exist. This structure is not returned if no data is available
items.description_zh: 不存在的转码作业ID列表，无数据时该结构不返回
